fields: [pic=1]Are you ready for our book club?
Oh… Was I supposed to read something…?
[pic=4]I’ve always wanted to be a part of a book club though!
Ah! Maybe we can make one here!
[pic=3]But for now, let me tell you about this one!
[pic=2]Have you heard of a book called Lyllith the Dragonslayer?
[pic=2]It’s a spinoff from a larger series called Scales And Tails. It’s a bunch of books in a low fantasy world.
[pic=3]All the books intertwine and tell a huge epic story filled with adventure, mystery, love, and death! It’s amazing!
[pic=3]See the title is also a play-on-words! Lyllith the Dragon SLAYER? or Lyllith the Dragon’s <bounce>LAYER!</bounce>
[pic=5]Buuuut, she’s only been with one dragon so far… <pause>There’s a slew of other creatures for sure, so…
[pic=4]Maybe that’s just hinting at what’s to come.
[pic=2]So as you can guess, Lyllith is the main character…
[pic=3]We were just passing by and got caught up in your story!
[pic=4]No no, it’s a book series I really like. I was just telling Rascal about it.
[pic=2]Oh that’s great! Again, don’t mind us, we’re just here to listen.
[pic=2]Do go on! I love hearing about how couples meet!
[pic=4]Ooooh! Yeah these two actually had some pretty rough beginnings!
[pic=4]The entire second book was about the random circumstances they would cross eachother’s paths, and butt heads.
[pic=2]Well…<pause> Rivals turned co-workers…<pause> Turned co-workers with benefits?
[pic=3]There was a nice little Winter scene that sums up how their dynamic is…
[pic=4]Aw! It’s the little genuine connections that do it!
They’ve been here for a while.
[pic=2]Heh, yeah we wanted to see what you guys were up to!
[pic=2]Yeah sorry! I didn’t mean to interrupt! I just got lost in the cuteness…
[pic=3]Oh, it’s just a scene and some characters from a book!
[pic=3]Rascal asked if I had any favorite books, and I was telling him about this one.
[pic=4]Yeah! Haha, I wasn’t expecting an audience heh!
[pic=2]How about… <pause>I turn up the heat and tell ya guys about one of the scenes between the two?
[pic=6]Blimey, between a Dragon and a Wolf?
[pic=3]Now close your eyes and imagine for a second…
*Fade to Game* *Camera close up on Charlotte*
[pic=1]I just loved this part of the book. So much passion and-
[pic=4]Gosh… <pause>I just read some pretty raunchy stuff…<pause> That’s embarassing…
[pic=2]Nonsense dear, that was a wonderful story!
[pic=3]Lyllith The Dragonslayer, right? She’s anything but embarassing!
[pic=3]I’m getting to it, I’m getting to it!
[pic=2]I thought y’all were forming an angry mob to finally throw me out!
[pic=5]Instead I got to hear about this hot story!
[pic=1]Right? I gotta get my paws on these books!
[pic=3]Oh sure! Whenever Claire finishes, you can borrow that copy!
[pic=4]Thank you for sharing that with us!
[pic=4]Would you guys…<pause> Be interested in another story some time?
[pic=3]Great! I’ll be sure to find something fun!
[pic=2]Hey Rascal, how did you like the stories?
[pic=5]It would’ve been easier to fill you in on the details if it was just us two. I wasn’t expecting the crowd.

Yeah! You did great! Everyone
seems really interested in the book!
[pic=5]Ah hah… When I think about speaking to everyone, my heart starts racing.
[pic=5]But it was easy just reading from the book!
[pic=2]Huh! I wouldn’t have pegged ya as a reader!
[pic=2]I’m not! But this seems like a great place to start!
[pic=1]Let me know when you get it! I want to read it too!
[pic=4]That was great. I’m really excited for the next story time!
[pic=2]Would you want more Lyllith the Dragonslayer? Or something else?
[pic=4]But I am curious…<pause> Does Lyllith ever… <pause><breath>Take</breath> the dragon?
[pic=3]Haha, I guess you’ll just have to see at the next story time!
